objective: Execute automation execution context end-to-end: Condition.valueVariable resolution, Config·Read/Overwrite runtime evaluation with rollback tracking and orphan recovery, chain context copying, and alert template rendering.

acceptance.criterion: Rhai codegen and eval_condition_tree resolve Condition.valueVariable from execution context sample.
acceptance.verification: Vitest compileToRhai tests and Cargo test eval_condition_tree_uses_value_variable_when_present

acceptance.criterion: Frontend IR emits flat contextReads and configOverwrite directives from canvas nodes, plus chainConfig.iterationLimit.
acceptance.verification: Vitest configDirectives, ir, and buildIr tests

acceptance.criterion: flow_config_overrides migration tracks original config values for rollback with unrestored index.
acceptance.verification: Cargo sqlx test applies migration and verifies table/index existence

acceptance.criterion: config_override helpers read/write numeric, text, bool, and integer DeviceConfig fields with variable lookup.
Config·Overwrite applies on condition true, restores on condition false, prevents duplicate backups, and recovers orphans on startup.
acceptance.verification: Cargo test services::config_override transition and orphan recovery tests

acceptance.criterion: services/config_context parses contextReads/configOverwrite from ir_json and resolves numeric fields against DeviceConfig.
Flow chain evaluation injects resolved context into alert and action command scripts, respects configured iteration limits, and copies context across chain when enabled.
Action·Alert template rendering replaces {{var}} and {{time}} tokens while leaving unresolved variables intact.
